**Coaching Note:**
Your queen attacked the undefended pawn on d3, but capturing with check was the key. This forced the king to e1, where your rook delivers checkmate on c1. When you spot an undefended piece, always check if capturing it with check wins more than just the piece itself. In-between moves (checks before recaptures) unlock tactics that simple captures miss.
